title: PhysxSphereFillCollisionAPI
summary: Sphere fill cooking parameters for a Mesh collider with physics:approximation sphereFill. Cooking inputs only; nothing here is verified. voxelResolution's schema fallback differs from the consumer's absent-column seed.
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied collision API is published at its resolved value; all four columns land as their raw fallbacks when unauthored. No derivation.

columns.name: physxSphereFillCollision:voxelResolution
columns.absent: 100000, the cooking default. The USD schema fallback is 50000 and the producer publishes it, so a hand-populated stage that omits the column voxelises twice as finely as USD population.

columns.name: physxSphereFillCollision:fillMode
columns.absent: flood, the cooking default. Accepted tokens flood, raycast, surface; an absent column or any other token keeps the current value.

interactions.rule: Read only for descriptor kind sphereFill. No usd-schemas gate: the columns are read whenever they exist on the collider.

findings.summary: Absent column seeds 100000 (the cooking default shared with convex decomposition) while the USD schema fallback published by the producer is 50000. Only a hand-populated stage that omits the column is affected. Cooking input, not a PhysX default.

notes: Cooking APIs on a Mesh cannot be verified by the generated tests: the parameters only change the set of PxSphereGeometry shapes the cooking service emits, PhysX exposes no getter for them, and the builder writes no mesh arrays.
